limitations: This is serialized graph expansion plus source/CDO branch resolution, not UE shader compilation or numeric evaluation of texture-dependent terms.
Dynamic texture samples, cloud sample attributes, WorldPosition, and remaining expressions are preserved as graph nodes.
The graph AST resolves only the actual default Deferred shading path; Forward/Mobile alternatives are not part of these active roots.
